'Çoklu soket takılmamış/gevşek' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to check the multi-plug and connections. This supports the candidate.
'Kablo demetinde kesinti' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to check all wiring harnesses and connections. This supports the candidate.
'Ateşleme sistemi arızalı' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to replace the ignition system. This supports the candidate.
'Topraklama hatalı' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to check the product's grounding. This supports the candidate.
'Elektronik arızalı' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to check the electronic board. This supports the candidate.
'Yanma Havası/Atık Gaz Akım Borusu tıkalı' is listed as a possible cause, with the instruction to check the air/flue system. This supports the candidate.
